title: Court summons former Keralam DGP R. Sreelekha in Rahul Gandhi defamation case

ai.summary: A court in Kerala summoned former Keralam DGP R. Sreelekha to appear in a criminal defamation case related to her alleged remarks about Rahul Gandhi's protest in Delhi, which she claimed was substance abuse-induced.

facts.claim: A court in Mavelikkara in Alappuzha district, Keralam, has issued a notice summoning former Director General of Police and BJP’s Thiruvananthapuram Corporation councillor R. Sreelekha to appear in person in a criminal defamation case
facts.quote: A court in Mavelikkara in Alappuzha district, Keralam, has issued a notice summoning former Director General of Police and BJP’s Thiruvananthapuram Corporation councillor R. Sreelekha to appear in person in a criminal defamation case

facts.claim: The case has been filed by Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee general secretary K.P. Sreekumar
facts.quote: The case has been filed by Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee general secretary K.P. Sreekumar

facts.claim: Ms. Sreelekha has been directed to appear before the court on December 2
facts.quote: Ms. Sreelekha has been directed to appear before the court on December 2

facts.claim: She allegedly made the remarks while addressing a public gathering organised by the BJP Kollam East District Committee in Punalur on October 14 in support of the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and Chief Election Commissioner of India Gyanesh Kumar
facts.quote: She allegedly made the remarks while addressing a public gathering organised by the BJP Kollam East District Committee in Punalur on October 14 in support of the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and Chief Election Commissioner of India Gyanesh Kumar

facts.claim: Ms. Sreelekha had allegedly attributed Mr. Gandhi’s protest in Delhi to a substance abuse-induced high
facts.quote: Ms. Sreelekha had allegedly attributed Mr. Gandhi’s protest in Delhi to a substance abuse-induced high

facts.claim: The State Police Chief had received several complaints following the alleged remarks
facts.quote: The State Police Chief had received several complaints following the alleged remarks

facts.claim: The Punalur police had also registered a case under Section 192 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for allegedly wantonly or maliciously giving provocation with the intent or knowledge that it could cause a riot
facts.quote: The Punalur police had also registered a case under Section 192 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for allegedly wantonly or maliciously giving provocation with the intent or knowledge that it could cause a riot

facts.claim: Ms. Sreelekha had subsequently doubled down on the allegation, accusing the State government of adopting double standards in its response to insults directed at Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Mr. Gandhi
facts.quote: Ms. Sreelekha had subsequently doubled down on the allegation, accusing the State government of adopting double standards in its response to insults directed at Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Mr. Gandhi

ai.background_note: The court summons relate to former Keralam DGP R. Sreelekha's alleged remarks about Rahul Gandhi's protest in Delhi, which she claimed was substance abuse-induced, in the context of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list recheck protests.
